verdict.rationale: There is thin evidence that the platform can set its own fees on top of Mangopay's costs. The docs say platform fees are collected and "automatically wired to your bank account every month," and the wallet infrastructure supports splitting funds. Community posts cite a published flat rate of 1.8% + €0.18, but that pricing is old and anecdotal. Missing for 10: first-party documented buy-rate or pricing schedule, explicit docs on setting per-transaction sell rates or fees, interchange-level or interchange++ cost reporting, and spread or margin reporting.
